question:
Six points are marked on a grid of unit squares as shown on the right. What is the smallest area of a triangle formed by three of these points?
<image1>
Choices:
A:$1 / 2$
B:$1 / 3$
C:$1 / 4$
D:1
E:2
author: /root/stem4
reason_zh: 原文Three of which form...为独立残句；建议自然表达，保留六点、单位方格及三点三角形最小面积。
preserved_conditions: 单位正方形网格六个标记点
选三点构成最小面积三角形
